item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine is using naval drones to strike Russian warships in Libya's Benghazi port, claiming lawful self-defence, while Russia has violated Finnish airspace with a helicopter and Polish airspace with an unmanned aerial vehicle. NATO's chief has pledged defence against a Russian space threat after reports that Russia is preparing a nuclear satellite launch, and MI5 has warned UK firms supplying Ukraine of sabotage risk. The UN Security Council warned that winter attacks on Ukraine's power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies. North Korea has halted military aid to Russia, according to Ukrainian intelligence. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
